_comment: Executable config for tools/run_scrape.py. search-queries.md stays the strategy
doc; this file is what cron actually runs.
defaults.portals is the automation backbone: arbeitsagentur (official federal
API), arbeitnow, and freehire are all public JSON APIs, safe to poll daily.
stepstone/xing/linkedin are HTML-scraped and two of them are personal-use-only
per their SKILL.md, so they are opted in per profile and kept low-volume.
portals: '+name' adds to defaults, '-name' removes; a list with no prefixes
portal_overrides: per-portal spellings and facets. The same search is written
differently on each board - LinkedIn needs 'Berlin, Germany' where StepStone
needs 'Berlin', and freehire has no location flag at all (it takes --city).
Any key here that is not query/location/jobage/limit is passed through as
--key value, so portal-specific facets need no code change.
